scope: Read-only verification of bounded notation corrections; no inference or numerical analysis altered.

conditional_identity_checks.scope: deterministic conditional identities for a historical submodel with specified covariance

recommendations.location: Historical-window VB coordinate updates, latent augmentation rate
recommendations.finding: A squared lacks its source superscript although B and sigma are channel specific.
recommendations.justification: The same channel constant A(gamma^j;p0) enters the conditional Gaussian offset; the retained conditional verifier uses psi=(A*A/B+2)/sigma.

recommendations.finding: Algorithm 3 increments k before calling the state update, but Algorithm 4 labels its outputs k+1.
recommendations.correction: Label both smoothing output factors r^(k); state that input augmentation and channel-parameter moments are from iteration k-1 and that the smoothed moments define the bold state mean and covariance at iteration k.
recommendations.justification: Algorithm 3 increments k before its state step, then uses the updated smoothed state moments in augmentation updates. The explicit input convention and moment alias remove the ambiguity without changing a recursion.

recommendations.location: Historical sampling algorithm, channel scale step
recommendations.finding: Parameters of a channel-wide conditional use a time subscript outside the time loop.
recommendations.correction: Use kappa_sigma^j, psi_sigma^j, chi_sigma^j for the channel-wide GIG shape, linear, and reciprocal parameters; retain every right-hand side and the prior hyperparameters a_{sigma^j}, b_{sigma^j}.
recommendations.justification: Scale is constant across the T historical observations in a channel; the conditional verifier checks the summed scale kernel and its inverse-gamma limit. Distinct Greek labels avoid confusing conditional parameters with prior hyperparameters.

recommendations.finding: beta is called a set of variational factors but appears as an unknown inside p(D,alpha,beta).
recommendations.correction: Define beta as the remaining unknown quantities with variational distribution r(beta).
recommendations.justification: Separates the random quantities from their approximating density in the coordinate-update expectation.

recommendations.location: Full stacked state and active forecast covariance dimension
recommendations.finding: Full state dimension q and time-varying active forecast dimension p_t require an explicit relationship.
recommendations.correction: Define M_t for t>T by the same block construction as D_t, retaining the trend-and-seasonal block, active source-discrepancy blocks, and the transfer block evaluated with x_t. At a source-availability change, restrict the preceding state to these retained coordinates; restrict selectors and covariances consistently. Use the same bold M_t notation in the covariance residual.
recommendations.justification: The existing covariance paragraph defines active dimension p_t and covariance restriction; the keep-dimension helper computes p*(active_sources+1)+transfer_dim. The authoritative transition construction builds an active principal trend/discrepancy block and appends the covariate-dependent transfer block. Neither the covariance formula nor fitted calculations changes.

implementation_boundary: No new posterior sampler, covariance prior, likelihood, state equations, convergence claims, or fitted results are introduced.

supporting_sources.use: Read-only active transition construction; no fitted model object read.
